relevance.reason: A bilateral digital partnership agreement amending the Korea-Singapore Free Trade Agreement's electronic-commerce chapter and containing a dedicated AI article. The AI provision promotes AI governance and ethics frameworks and cross-border business opportunities; it is cooperative.
ai_provisions: Article 14.28 — Artificial Intelligence: cross-border opportunities for business innovation; adoption of AI governance and ethics frameworks; trusted, safe and responsible use
relevance.excluded_scope: The AI article is programmatic and does not impose enforceable AI standards or prohibitions.
